purpose: Replacement equipment-class illustrations for undersized or mismatched existing assets; remaining suitable references retained and reframed.

entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one high resolution 2048 by 1536 landscape catalogue illustration for Bart Mining's belt conveyor equipment page. A single realistic industrial aggregate belt conveyor: long inclined black rubber belt with correctly spaced steel troughing idler rollers, guarded electric drive and head pulley, steel truss support legs and a loading hopper at the lower end. Show the entire standalone conveyor in three-quarter side view, fully inside the frame with generous clear margins on all sides. Neutral warm off-white studio background and floor, soft diffuse daylight, restrained steel grey structure with yellow safety guards, crisp realistic metal/rubber textures. Product occupies about 75 percent of frame width. No quarry panorama, snow, people, logos, watermarks, text, branding, specifications or unrelated machinery. This is a generic equipment-class illustration, not a documentary photo or exact model. It must fit a 4:3 catalogue card and a 16:9 product window without cropping the machine. Save this generated deliverable for the website; report its output file path.
